about: Which model answers each task. Spec = provider:model. Override any task with an environment variable AI_MODEL_<TASK> (CHAT, ANSWER_CHECK, QUERY_REWRITE, TEMPLATE_PICK, DRAFTING, REVIEW, RERUN, OCR), for example AI_MODEL_CHAT=anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5. Providers: gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY), anthropic (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), litellm (LITELLM_BASE_URL + LITELLM_API_KEY, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). thinking: off | minimal | low | medium | high. firstTokenMs: give up on a model that has produced no text by then (0 = never) and use the fallback; fallback: tried in order when a model is busy or unavailable (override with AI_FALLBACK_<TASK>, comma-separated, empty = none). See docs/PAID-SWITCHOVER.md.

retry.about: When a model answers 'unavailable' (503, or cannot be reached) before any text: wait waitMs and ask the SAME model again `times` times, and only then move to the task's fallback model. A task can set its own "retryUnavailable": {"times":0} to turn it off. Rate limits (429) and timeouts go straight to the fallback.
